pages.text: Draconic Evolution has no official release for Minecraft 26.1. This server runs an unofficial community port of DE 3.1.4 with extra fixes and features added for this pack.$(br2)Most blocks and items work as in the official mod. A few systems have $(c)not been tested$() here yet, so treat them with care and keep backups.

pages.title: Untested
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:endgame/reactor)Draconic Reactor$(/l). Try it in a copy of the world first.$(li)The $(l:endgame/chaos_guardian)Chaos Guardian$(/l) fight. Back up before fighting.$(li)Modular tools and armour in heavy combat.$(li)Dislocators and portals.$(br2)If something breaks, tell the server admin what you did and when.

pages.title: On this server
pages.text: $(li)Draconium ore in the Overworld is rare; the End is the main source. Chunks generated before DE was added got ore afterwards.$(li)The End and Nether were reset so they contain DE ore and Chaos Islands. Islands sit inside the End border.$(li)$(c)Never move an Energy Core with AE2 Spatial IO.$() Core blocks refuse to be moved for that reason.

pages.title: Added in this port
pages.text: $(li)Jade tooltips for the core, pylons and stabilizers.$(li)Core screen shows in, out, net and time to full or empty.$(li)Pylons say their mode when toggled and are coloured green (input) or red (output).$(li)An eye button to hide core effects, plus a render-distance setting.$(li)DE machines push energy straight into cables such as Powah's.$(li)This guide. The Information Tablet opens it too.

pages.title: Known quirks
pages.text: $(li)The core screen used to show only the net rate; Shift is no longer needed.$(li)Pylons do nothing while the core is inactive: check the core's power button first.$(li)The Information Tablet has no recipe, as in the official mod; craft this book from a Book and Draconium Dust instead.
